mostWorthwhile.text: Making the membrane patch was worthwhile because the picture explained how the water-facing heads and water-avoiding tails form two layers.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to add the sugar carrier to the membrane with a water channel was frustrating: it could not combine with anything, even though both proteins seemed suited to the membrane.

surprise.text: I expected both proteins to fit into the same patch, but the sugar carrier worked with a separate patch instead.

arbitrary.text: Using a separate patch for the sugar carrier felt somewhat arbitrary; the pictures did not explain why the channel patch could not also accept it.

continue.text: I would choose to continue because the pictures made the different ways substances cross a membrane understandable, though I would hope future combinations make their restrictions clearer.
